Focused Energy is an international deep-tech company based in Germany and the US, working to commercialize laser-driven nuclear fusion. The laser amplification chain scales the beam energy needed by our fusion system. Developing it involves complex technical decisions, interdependent teams and requirements that evolve as the programme advances.
